data.summary: Detail-oriented finance professional with 6+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Trade Settlement, Reconciliation, and Client Management. Proven expertise in Equity and OTC listed derivative settlement across DTCC and Euroclear. Hands-on experience in SSI validation and maintenance, pre-matching, settlement fails, month-end closing, end-of-day balancing, reconciliation, and CSDR-related controls. Strong track record of resolving settlement exceptions, coordinating with brokers and custodians, and delivering accurate client reporting.

responsibilities: Managed daily settlement of high-value Equity and OTC listed derivative products.

Performed hands-on pre-matching and settlement activities, checking and ensuring SSI accuracy in counterparty SWIFT messages for trades across DTC and Euroclear markets and amending instructions when required.
Maintained and updated Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) in ALERT, supporting accurate settlement and reducing instruction-related fails.
Performed trade confirmation and pre-matching to reduce fails, overdraft charges, and CSDR penalties.
Performed end-of-day balancing activities, validating settlement and cash/position records and investigating discrepancies before daily close.
Supported month-end closing activities, completing required reconciliations, validations, and outstanding-item checks to ensure accurate and timely operational close.
Liaised with trading desks, sales, IT teams, brokers, and custodians to ensure seamless end-to-end settlement processing.
Resolved failing trades by coordinating with brokers and custodians on shorts, stock loans, and instruction mismatches.
Monitored the group mailbox to ensure queries were actioned on time according to priority and SLA requirements.
Collected and validated real estate data from institutional clients including income, expense components, and property details for completeness and accuracy.
Analysed income and expense components to ensure data integrity.
Performed reconciliation of real estate data by comparing current vs. historical records; identified discrepancies and coordinated client clarifications.
Generated monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual benchmark reports for clients based on subscription packages.
Empowered clients to make informed financial decisions through clear communication on investment products tailored to individual financial goals.
Managed end-to-end KYC onboarding process and provided technical support for client integration into company systems.
Managed a dedicated client base of 1,500+ investors, building long-term relationships to drive satisfaction, loyalty, and AUM retention.
Provided information on market scenarios and catered to short- and long-term investment needs.
Delivered goal-based mutual fund guidance and resolved investment and operational queries.
Facilitated onboarding of CASA accounts and provided end-to-end support for loan and credit card applications.
Drove portfolio growth by identifying client needs and cross-selling tailored insurance and financial solutions.

education.institution: Shankar Narayan Arts, Science & Commerce College, Mumbai
